Initial plan and authority seam
1. Resolve and publish the frozen base, read BC #161 in full including comments,
   inspect live #162 source, and distinguish production owners from fixtures.
2. Establish exact admitted reader/incarnation, trusted complete-history origin,
   and the candidate's supported binding/route contract before implementation.
3. Only if gate 2 succeeds: bind the existing toolBindings transport to the
   session/run owner, await durable selected-source pending writes before return,
   and settle only an exact host result/model-input handoff. Preserve pending
   custody on cancellation/restart and cover the sibling tool-return path.
4. Obtain the mandatory RED-to-GREEN and exact-worktree GitNexus receipts, then
   submit the bounded source candidate to Ronan. Do not dispatch broad CI before
   that review gate. After authorized acceptance use blessed hybrid CI with

Concrete blockers
1. The exact BC candidate's exposure port requires LocalReader. Its real
   parseConfig rejects a continuing Discord reader: config.ts:95-103 requires
   an exact local subagent. Binding.exactLocalCaller at binding.ts:550-557 also
   requires subagent, exact session ID, sandboxed=true, and a current assertion.
   Its entry at index.ts:22 expects api.session.state.resolveLocalSessionRoute.
   At the frozen OpenClaw main, git grep over src/packages/extensions finds no
   resolvePluginLocalSessionRoute, resolveLocalSessionRoute, canticle.exposure,
   or canticle-exposure-port implementation. The old audited host resolver is
   not a current-main continuing-reader contract. Broadening BC or restoring
   a retired API is not authorized by silently editing this OpenClaw lane.
2. No trusted complete prior-exposure origin, owner-ledger identity, or
   host-to-station verifier provisioning is supplied for the continuing prince.
   Ronan's #161 inventory explicitly reports records_lost, legacy taint-only
   reception, and unattested history. Creating an empty SQLite ledger cannot
   change that fact. Current run identity assertions alone do not attest history.
3. Exact result custody remains unproved. The BC port only begins pending;
   it exposes no host settlement API. Current tool-result middleware may
   normalize/change/withhold output (harness/tool-result-middleware.ts:265-289).
   Plugin return, successful begin, messaging-delivery facts, and a passive
   llm_input observation are not interchangeable with exact provider handoff.
   No confirmation has been synthesized.
